faq_heading: Homes near Gabrielle-Roy: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Gabrielle-Roy catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Conseil scolaire francophone School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Gabrielle-Roy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Gabrielle-Roy. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.
